_comment: Every id, pool and decimal below was read from NEAR testnet by RPC view call and proven with a live get_return quote (see scripts/verify-testnet.mjs). Nothing here is from memory. This file exists so the contract can be exercised end to end for free; mainnet remains the real target and lives in addresses.near.json.

dex.name: Ref Finance (testnet deployment)
dex.note: Testnet has no Rhea-branded deployment; ref-finance-101.testnet is the live testnet exchange. Only SIMPLE_POOL pools are used - the contract's routing assumes the classic AMM, and testnet's DEGEN_SWAP pools panic with 'E129: Degens expired' on any quote.

usdc.note: Chosen because it is the deepest 6-decimal USDC on a classic wrap.testnet pool that actually quotes. Six decimals matters: the contract pins USDC_DECIMALS = 6, so a 24-decimal testnet USDC (usdc.itachicara.testnet) would need a code change. Passed to `new` as usdc_id, which is an Option - no rebuild needed.

routing_note: Same shape as mainnet: one USDC/wNEAR hub pool (#2082), and every other token quoted against wNEAR so buys and sells route USDC -> wNEAR -> token as one two-hop swap. Hop pool ids below were each confirmed to hold the pair, to hold liquidity on both sides, and to return a non-zero get_return quote for $100.
charts_note: GeckoTerminal indexes mainnet only, so there is no gecko_terminal_pool for any testnet pool. Candles, 24h volume and swap pressure are unavailable on testnet and the UI will say so. Prices, pool depth, price impact and every contract-sourced number still work.
